explanation: Native zero-count range is exactly one generated whitespace character between catch closing brace and finally keyword. It contains no executable token. v8-to-istanbul remaps it to the original catch closing brace and counts every block range as a branch. This establishes an instrumentation/source-mapping artifact, not 100% reported V8 branch coverage.
policy: Preserve reported metric. No coverage exclusions, ignored branches, reduced denominator, relaxed thresholds or production changes.
rawEvidenceLabel: Retained original native V8 diagnostic capture, identified by nativeSha256

origins.nativeFile: Original diagnostic capture retained separately; identified by SHA256.
origins.mappedSource: Repository-relative production source path; offsets and hashes are unchanged.
